sources.review_notes: All 41 pages reviewed against page renders by three reviewer agents (reports/review-pages-0001-0014.md, -0015-0028.md, -0029-0041.md): 68 extractor warnings resolved (running headers and footers omitted with reasons), 67 picture regions merged into 35 figures and checked by crops, equations (1)-(40) transcribed from 200-300 dpi crops, Table 1 and the Figure 11 table as cells, Algorithm 1 as image plus transcription, 94 reference entries rebuilt one per item. Verifier diagnostics are LaTeX-notation, degree-sign and minus-glyph differences, adjudicated per page. The coordinator re-joined two paragraphs split around floats (pages 25 and 31) using a reading order.
